patch.value: Make scheduled closeout and sync refusals actionable

Scheduled fleet closeout fails behind a generic workflow refusal; sync also fails import or repeat-idempotency gates. Diagnose real scheduled jobs in at least four repositories and repair package-owned causes without editing callers. Related historical closeout policy work: pm-github-f1ev and pm-github-2o9k.

Record exact run/job evidence across four repositories for both workflows; compare current published release with caller pins. Scheduled closeout and sync either succeed or emit one precise safe actionable diagnostic identifying the failed API read or tracker item and validation requirement. Cover each failure class with real tracker and HTTP/workflow regression tests, record behavioral revert proof, pass unchanged npm and Bun release gates, and open an unmerged PR with green CI.
